_comment: Per-entry review of formula.herb_drug_interactions_en. Hand-authored — this is a judgement about each statement, not derived data, so it is NOT generated by a script. text_sha1 pins the verdict to the exact wording reviewed: edit the statement and the validator reports it unreviewed again. Renderer contract: only entries with render_eligible=true may ever reach the screen.
reviewer: Fable (routing) — clinical wording and final render decision belong to Ting

verdicts.HOLD_UNSOURCED_BENEFIT: Benefit-direction claim with no statement-level source. Card-level source_urls point at vendor/aggregator front pages, not at this claim.
verdicts.HOLD_REVERSES_INTENDED_DRUG_EFFECT: Claims to undo an effect the prescriber wants. Acting on it can defeat the treatment.
verdicts.HOLD_MASKS_WARNING_SIGN: The symptom described is a warning sign that should reach the prescriber. Treating it can hide deterioration.
verdicts.HOLD_PRECLINICAL_AS_CLINICAL: Animal or in-vitro finding phrased as if it applied to patients.
verdicts.RISK_DIRECTION_KEEP: States a hazard rather than a benefit. Keep; needs sourcing and stronger wording, not removal.

formula.xiao_chai_hu_tang#0.note: 2026-08-12 升級:措辭從「maybe associated」改為併用禁忌,掛上 PubMed 8980988 / 7575138 與 LiverTox NBK548777。組成七味與日本 TJ-9 相同,故日方藥物警戒適用(查證過,非推論)。本庫唯一允許進畫面的交互作用敘述 —— 它講的是危害,其餘 25 段講的是效益且無來源。原句保留在該卡的 superseded_statements。

_quarantine_note: 2026-08-27 A0b(b) Ting 裁定:25 段 HOLD_* 移入各卡 unsourced_claims_quarantine;僅 formula.xiao_chai_hu_tang#0(併用禁忌,RISK_DIRECTION_KEEP)存活於欄位並允許渲染。
